name: delete_attached_object_effects_by_id

stack.evidence: func_001E0C38 consumes one effect ID, stores it in an event-effect task record, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001E0C38 queues dispatcher state 9. State 9 scans the eight attachment records created by state 7 for matching effect IDs, frees each matching PPP effect through func_00177828 and func_00181200, and clears its record. The JP corpus contains 64 calls; representative reward scripts use ID 0 before opening animation and ID 1 after command 535 spawn_selected_object_effect.
